The '''Oppressor flamethrower''' was a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame projector]] sometimes used by the [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. It was the standard equipment of the [[Incinerator stormtrooper/Legends|incinerator stormtroopers]].
